name: wagon-circle
description: One VS Code room for you, Claude and Codex. Both agents run as private child processes over stdio: no daemon, no open ports.

wagonCircle.userName.description: Your name as the agents see it and as the room labels your messages. Empty = first name from git config user.name, else your login name.

wagonCircle.claudeModel.description: Model alias or id passed to claude --model.

wagonCircle.claudePath.description: Path to the claude CLI. Empty = the newest one found (the VS Code Claude extension's bundled CLI or ~/.local/bin/claude).

wagonCircle.codexPath.description: Path to the codex CLI. Empty = ~/.local/bin/codex, then the standalone install, then PATH.

wagonCircle.hopCap.description: Max agent-to-agent hand-offs per message you send.

wagonCircle.cwd.description: Working folder both agents may read. Empty = first workspace folder.

wagonCircle.defaultTarget.description: Who leads new rooms: messages with no @mention go to the lead. Change per room with the Lead chip or /default.

wagonCircle.bothMode.description: How @both works: sequential = take turns, the second sees the first answer; parallel = answer at once. Change per room with /both.

wagonCircle.ideContext.description: Attach what you are looking at in VS Code (active file, selection or visible lines, open tabs, problems) to each message. Toggle per room with the 📍 chip.

wagonCircle.claudeEffort.description: Claude effort for new rooms. Empty = Claude Code default. Set from a room with "Use for new rooms".

wagonCircle.codexModel.description: Codex model for new rooms (e.g. gpt-6-astra). Empty = your Codex config default. Set from a room with "Use for new rooms".

wagonCircle.codexEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort for new rooms. Empty = the model default.

author: Dean Buttry
